d: Jet black, floor-length hair flows in voluminous waves, featuring a middle parting and long bangs. The eyes are completely obscured by a white, textured blindfold, while the visible expression is a subtle, mature smile on a face reflecting a person in their late twenties or early thirties. The build is slender and elegant, dressed in a complex ensemble consisting of a white collared blouse with an open neckline, a deep crimson wrap around the waist, and a massive, flowing black skirt that transitions into ink-like tentacles at the base. Signature details include a small blue gemstone pendant at the throat and glowing pink crystalline shards floating around the hands.
